item.title: Rescuers use drone technology to find dog that escaped along New Jersey Turnpike
item.description: A dog escaped from a rest stop along the New Jersey Turnpike and wandered for about 25 miles (40 kilometers) before she was found safe the next day with help from a drone.

item.title: Gang member convicted in cemetery ambush that killed two in Brunswick County
item.description: A man will spend at least 25 years in prison after being convicted of multiple charges in Brunswick County Superior Court Wednesday.

item.title: Multiple organizations to plant more than 100 trees in Wilmington
item.description: The Alliance for Cape Fear Trees (ACFT) will lead the planting of more than 100 trees in Wilmington's Northside neighborhood on Saturday.

item.title: Avelo Airlines scales back at Wilmington Airport, eliminates 11 destinations
item.description: Avelo Airlines is closing its base at Wilmington International Airport and cutting service from ILM to 11 destinations.

item.title: ‘Not the man we know;’ Wife of man charged in Wilmington alleged kidnapping speaks out
item.description: WILMINGTON, NC (WWAY-TV) – The wife of a Wrightsville Beach man accused of second-degree kidnapping a child in downtown Wilmington spoke out on Wednesday. item.title: James Beard-nominated chef opens new restaurant in Wilmington
item.description: WILMINGTON, NC (WWAY-TV) – An award-winning chef has opened a new restaurant in downtown Wilmington. Keith Rhodes, a two-time James Beard nominee soft launched his new bistro, Voyce, earlier this month. The restaurant is located at 11 Market Street in downtown. item.title: Trump proposes massive increase in 2027 defense spending to $1.5T, citing ‘dangerous times’
item.description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday proposed setting U.S. military spending at $1.5 trillion in 2027, citing “troubled and dangerous times.”

item.title: Derek Sprague steps down as CEO of PGA of America to care for his family in New York
item.description: Derek Sprague is leaving after one year as CEO at the PGA of America, wishing to return to upstate New York to help support his mother and mother-in-law, who are requiring more care.

item.title: Millions celebrate Orthodox Christmas on Jan. 7, following ancient traditions
item.description: Millions of people around the world celebrated Orthodox Christmas on Wednesday, nearly two weeks after much of the world marked the holy day.

item.title: Nudist resort in Ocean Isle Beach is looking to expand its campground
item.description: Whispering Pines Nudist Resort is looking to expand its campsite with additional vehicles spaces. They will hope to move forward with the project with a permit by the Brunswick Board of Adjustment.
